title: Potato and {p} Tortilla with {v}
steps: Slice the {s} thin. Cook in a generous splash of oil in a deep skillet over medium-low heat with the {v}, stirring often, until very tender, about 15 minutes.
Beat the {p} with salt and the {spice}. Stir in the warm {s} and {v} and leave for 5 minutes.
Add the mixture to the skillet and cook over medium-low heat until the edges are set, about 8 minutes. Flip with a plate and cook the other side until the eggs are firm all the way through.
Slice into wedges and serve with the {sauce}.
tip: Use less oil by cooking the potatoes in a covered nonstick pan, and add extra vegetables to the eggs.
